Class InstantEffectBuilding

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.BuildingCard
it.polimi.ingsw.model.BuildingCards.InstantEffectBuilding
public class InstantEffectBuilding extends BuildingCard
Represents a specialized BuildingCard that grants instant effects or continuous passive abilities to a player upon acquisition. These effects include star modifiers, loss prevention, scoring multipliers, and bonuses to card drawing or resource gathering.

  • Constructor Details

    • InstantEffectBuilding

      public InstantEffectBuilding(String id, int era, int minPlayer, boolean isObtainable, int foodCost, int prestigePoints, int extraStars, boolean preventLoss, boolean doubleOnWinning, boolean extraCardFromUpper, boolean extraFoodFromBonus)
      Constructs a new InstantEffectBuilding with the specified attributes and active effect flags.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the card
      era - the historical era or age this card belongs to
      minPlayer - the minimum number of players required for this card to be active
      isObtainable - true if the card can currently be acquired by players
      foodCost - the amount of food required to construct/buy this building
      prestigePoints - the raw prestige or victory points awarded by this card
      extraStars - the number of additional stars granted by this building
      preventLoss - true if this building prevents a specific type of penalty or resource loss
      doubleOnWinning - true if this building doubles the rewards or points when a winning condition is met
      extraCardFromUpper - true if this building allows drawing an extra card from the upper row
      extraFoodFromBonus - true if this building yields extra food whenever a bonus is triggered
